trust.label: Ownership
trust.heading: What you get to keep.
trust.t1: You own the code, outright, from day one.
trust.b1: No page builder, no theme, no licence that expires.
trust.b2: The site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Any developer can continue it.
trust.b3: Right-to-left is built in, not bolted on. This site is the proof.
trust.b4: Canonical structure, hreflang, structured data and clean markup from the start.
trust.b5: Analytics and attribution are prepared, and configured where you have the accounts.
trust.b6: You see the site before it launches, and you approve what goes live.

faq.label: Questions
faq.heading: Straight answers.
faq.q1: How long does a ZOHAR website take to build?
faq.a1: A marketing site is typically 3 to 7 working days once the brief is agreed and the content is with us. Stores and systems are quoted individually, with the timeline set before work starts.
faq.q2: What exactly do I own at the end?
faq.a2: The full source: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images and configuration. You can host it anywhere and any developer can continue it. There is no licence to renew and no platform to stay on.
faq.q3: How many rounds of changes are included?
faq.a3: Two consolidated revision rounds, within the brief we agreed. Each round comes to us as one list rather than messages spread over weeks, which is what keeps the timeline and the price predictable. An additional round is ₪650. Work outside the agreed brief — a change of direction, extra pages, new functionality — is ₪300 per hour or quoted up front.
faq.q4: Do you work in languages other than Hebrew and English?
faq.a4: Yes. Multilingual implementation is part of the service, and right-to-left languages are handled properly rather than mirrored as an afterthought.
faq.q5: Can you move my existing WordPress site?
faq.a5: Where it is genuinely deliverable, yes — we rebuild the content in owned code rather than migrating the plugins. We will tell you honestly if your site is a poor fit.
faq.a6: No. We build the structure that makes results possible and we prepare the measurement that shows whether they happened. Anyone guaranteeing a number before seeing your market is guessing.
faq.q7: What does it cost, and how is it paid?
faq.a7: The final proposal is defined after a short brief and depends on scope, languages and functionality — online stores, multilingual websites and custom systems are quoted separately. Payment is 50% at project start and 50% before production launch. Domain registration and paid third-party services are not included.
faq.a8: Not yet. It is in development. Today every ZOHAR website is created through the Done-For-You process, and we do not take payment for anything that is not ready.
faq.q9: What happens to hosting after the first year?
faq.a9: The first year of secure managed static hosting is included, subject to reasonable use. Domains, paid third-party services, abnormal traffic and paid server functions sit outside it. After that you can renew hosting and basic management at ₪600 per year, or move the code to your own hosting account — it is your code, so there is no dependency on us either way.
